name: curb_place_id
description: Unique identifier for a curb place (span, area, or zone)

name: curb_place_type
description: Type of curb place: span, area, or zone

name: street_name
description: Name of the street where the curb place is located

name: cross_street_start
description: Name of the cross street at the start of the curb span

name: cross_street_end
description: Name of the cross street at the end of the curb span

name: linear_location
description: Location along a street expressed as a distance from a reference point

name: geometry
description: GeoJSON geometry representing the curb place location

name: policy_id
description: Unique identifier for a curb policy

name: policy_name
description: Human-readable name for the curb policy

name: rules
description: Array of rule objects defining what is allowed or prohibited at the curb

name: rule_order
description: Priority order of a rule within a policy (lower number = higher priority)

name: activity
description: The activity regulated by the rule (e.g., parking, loading, no stopping)

name: who
description: Array of user classes the rule applies to (e.g., permit holders, commercial vehicles)

name: rate
description: Pricing information for the regulated activity

name: rate_amount
description: Cost per unit time or transaction for the curb use

name: rate_unit
description: Unit of time for the rate (e.g., hour, minute, day)

name: time_spans
description: Array of time span objects defining when the rule is in effect

name: days_of_week
description: Days of week the rule applies (e.g., Mo, Tu, We)

name: time_of_day_start
description: Start time of day the rule is in effect (HH:MM 24-hour format)

name: time_of_day_end
description: End time of day the rule is in effect (HH:MM 24-hour format)

name: max_stay
description: Maximum duration a vehicle may stay at the curb under this rule (minutes)

name: no_return
description: Minimum time before a vehicle may return after reaching the max stay limit (minutes)

name: permit_zones
description: Residential permit zone identifiers that modify who the rule applies to

name: prioritization_tier
description: Tier indicating the regulatory priority of the curb policy (1=highest)

name: published_date
description: Date the curb data was published

name: effective_date
description: Date the policy went into effect

name: expiration_date
description: Date the policy expires, if applicable

name: prev_policies
description: Array of policy IDs this policy supersedes

name: data_source_operator_id
description: Identifier of the organization that published this curb data
